title: Development and external validation of an interpretable machine learning model for predicting prolonged postoperative ICU length of stay in coronary artery bypass grafting patients using MIMIC-IV 3.1 and eICU-CRD 2.0
summary: Nine models on MIMIC-IV CABG development (n=6,919) with eICU external validation (n=5,972), predicting ICU stay >3 days from first 24h features. CatBoost internal test AUC .774 and external AUC .645; calibration close to ideal. Modest external discrimination; prospective validation required. The publisher lists 2026/12; the first version reporting this result is dated 2026-06-27.
